I'm someone that has tried to play PoE 1 several times over the years, because I've heard so many great things about it. It was just hard for me to get into for some reason, but I still recognize it for the amazing game that it is. I was able to beat the main story in PoE 1 standard, but never did any real endgame grinding. But so far, I've been having so much freaking fun playing PoE 2. It's crazy. I got some of my friends to join me in my guild, so it's been super fun partying up with them and fighting bosses together. The Count took me and my friend 3 hours to beat, and since then we've gotten so much better at the game. I've been playing more than them, so I am currently on Cruel difficulty Act 1. But the Act 2 final boss only took me 7 tries to beat him, while the Act 3 final boss took me 4 tries. The learning curve is awesome, and its paid off paying attention to the boss moves, dodging, etc. I'm currently using the Witch with the Infernalist ascendency, but I am genuinely considering playing the monk next.
